newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Chile's Enersis eyeing Brazil power privatizations.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Enersis eyeing Brazil power privatizations.

text.p: Chile's power group Enersis is eyeing all new privatization opportunities in Brazil's power sector, a company official said.

"We are strongly interested in the Brazilian power sector," Ricardo Alvial, the company's Investor Relations director, told reporters, adding that Enersis is also eyeing deals in Colombia, Argentina and Mexico.
Last year, Enersis together with its distribution subsidiary Chilectra, Spain's Endesa and Portugal's EDP acquired 70 percent of Rio de Janeiro's power utility Cerj.

Alvial, speaking at a conference on Latin American utilities organized by Caspian Securities, said Brazil's strong commitment to creating a new regulatory model for the electrical sector has encouraged Enersis to increase its participation in the country's power sector.
"We believe that Brazilian authorities are on the right track, although the regulatory environment is not ready yet," he said.
Alvial said Enersis is mostly interested in generation and distribution. He also said the company would also consider opportunities in water utilities in Brazil.
((-- Fatima Cristina, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom 5521 5074151))
